title: Лунный ледник
palette: Glacier blue, pale cyan ice, white snow, cold cobalt cracks and moon-silver metal. Very sparse violet highlights. No beige limestone or coral flags.
terrain: An angular split ice shelf with two broad staggered levels joined by a smooth wide snow ramp, faceted blue frozen underside and a large diagonal fissure.
landmarks: One thick translucent-blue ice arch, an off-center low silver crescent beacon, three chunky frost boulders and a small still frozen lake. Sparse winter shrubs, no cypresses.
road: A broad blue-grey gritted snow trail clearly contrasting with white snow; smooth gentle ramps without stairs, no full-loop edging.
journey: Sweep around a frost boulder, turn inward across the lower shelf, pass under the thick ice arch, curve along the frozen lake, then gradually climb the broad ramp and change heading again. Then follow the NEW guide return corridor back into the beginning smoothly and continue the same winding circuit as many times as needed.
style: Clean crystalline winter shapes, soft snow volume and readable thick ice forms.
architecture: Two squat radio homes embedded into NORTHWEST ice ridge above the lake; one moon-silver workshop on SOUTHEAST lobe beyond the lower bend. Frosted blue metal roofs, cobalt doors, warm brass round vents and thick roof antenna forks. Retain low crescent beacon on NORTHEAST with chunky geared base. No tall central tower.
